description: On the Ouranoupoli waterfront, the square stone Prosforios tower stands beside a small harbor and a few boats. Across the water, Mount Athos is only a distant dark peak at the end of the peninsula. Cloud cover is about 2% at the quay, about 17.1°C. The summit model cell reported no snow, so the peak is bare. No monastery is shown.
